# Roll Credits

> A personal cinema-ticket-themed tracker for movies and TV shows. Users search The Movie Database (TMDB) for titles, add them to a watchlist styled as cinema tickets, mark them watched, rate them, add notes, and can let the app randomly pick what to watch next.

Roll Credits is a personal-use web app, not a public content or media site. Each visitor's or account's library (watchlist, ratings, watched history, notes) is private to them — there is no shared catalog of content to crawl beyond the app shell itself.

## Pages

- [Home](https://roll-credits-titles.vercel.app/): overview and a random-pick tool for what to watch tonight.
- [Movies](https://roll-credits-titles.vercel.app/movies): the signed-in or local user's movie collection.
- [Shows](https://roll-credits-titles.vercel.app/shows): the signed-in or local user's TV show collection.
- [Browse](https://roll-credits-titles.vercel.app/browse): browse the collection by genre.
- [Search](https://roll-credits-titles.vercel.app/search): search TMDB and add titles to the collection.

## Notes for automated agents

- Movie and show metadata (titles, posters, overviews, ratings) is sourced live from TMDB (themoviedb.org) and is not owned or authored by Roll Credits.
- Streaming-availability data is sourced from JustWatch via TMDB, for Egypt only.
- The `/account` and `/review` pages show private, per-user data and are excluded from indexing (see robots.txt).
